skill_name: Explain artificial neural networks and why they are used.
workflow: Artificial neural networks are a type of machine learning model which can be used for predictive analytics and decision-making. They are inspired by biological neurons and use layers of interconnected nodes to estimate, classify, or predict variables from data. Each node is responsible for processing, combining and weighing data, with the output of each layer being fed as input to the next layer.
